headline: Sensex and Nifty surge as markets bounce back, led by auto and banking sectors despite initial global concerns

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Broad-based buying interest in the auto and banking sectors
Bank Nifty hitting a record high during the session
Recovery from initial volatility caused by hawkish US Fed signals
Strong volume and price action in the National Stock Exchange stock
whatHappening: Sensex surged 990 points to reclaim the 83,000 level
Nifty 50 crossed 25,500 for the first time since February
IT and metal stocks faced selling pressure in early trade
Gift Nifty had initially signaled a gap-down opening for the market
summary: Indian markets staged a strong recovery, with the Sensex surging nearly 1,000 points and Nifty reclaiming the 25,500 mark. The rally was primarily driven by the banking and auto sectors, with Bank Nifty reaching a new record high. This bounce-back occurred despite early pressure from global cues and concerns over US Fed rate hikes.
